common.demoBanner: You're viewing the shared live demo — data resets every hour.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Your key is derived from your password — it never leaves this device.
login.cryptoNote: Unlocking your data — this can take a few seconds.
login.sessionNote: Opening a new tab will ask you to re-enter your password to unlock your data there. Your key is kept only in each tab's memory, never stored.
login.demoNote: A shared demo account with sample data — resets every hour.

unlockTab.title: Unlock this tab
unlockTab.subtitle: You're logged in, but your session is open in another tab. Enter your password to decrypt data here too.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentConfirmation: If that email has an account, we've sent a link to reset the password.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.subtitle: We'll email you a link to activate your account.
signup.sentConfirmation: If that email is allowed to sign up, we've sent a link to activate the account.
signup.notOpenMessage: Self-registration isn't currently open. Ask someone at your organization for an invite.

createCompany.title: Start a new company
createCompany.subtitle: Create your company's workspace and become its first admin.
createCompany.sentConfirmation: If that email is available, we've sent a link to activate your account as the company's first admin.
createCompany.notOpenMessage: Self-service company creation isn't available on this instance.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.warningHeading: This will replace your encryption key
resetPassword.warningText: Your password is also the root of your encryption key. Resetting it creates a new key — 1:1s encrypted under your old key will become unreadable until access is restored by your counterparts. Your private meeting notes can't be recovered at all: nobody else holds a copy.
resetPassword.riskAcknowledgeLabel: I understand my existing 1:1s will be unreadable until access is restored.
resetPassword.lookupError: Could not load this reset link.

accountSettings.title: Account settings
accountSettings.subtitle: Change your password. Your existing 1:1s stay readable — the key itself doesn't change.
accountSettings.draftMigrationError: Couldn't prepare your unpublished drafts for the password change, so the password was not changed. Please try again.
accountSettings.displayNameHint: Shown to your counterparts throughout the app instead of your email.
accountSettings.meetingRemindersHint: Reminders before a meeting and "not filled out yet" nudges. You'll still always get an email when a new 1:1 is scheduled with you.
accountSettings.dateFormatHint: How dates are displayed throughout the app, on this device.
accountSettings.exportHint: Download everything you can currently see — your own answers (including unpublished drafts), your counterparts' published answers, comments, outcomes, goals, and your private notes — as a JSON file.
accountSettings.deleteWarningText: Your 1:1s stay intact for your counterparts — deleting your account never touches shared history. Your own unpublished drafts are permanently lost, and your profile and encryption keys are removed.
accountSettings.deleteRiskAcknowledgeLabel: I understand this cannot be undone.

activate.title: Activate account
activate.lookupError: Could not load this activation link.
activate.keyExplainer: This password creates your encryption key. It's never sent to the server — choose one you can remember, since it can't be recovered for you.
activate.nameHint: Shown to your counterparts instead of your email. Optional — you can add it later in Account settings.
activate.oneTimeNote: This link only works once. After activating, you'll be logged in automatically.
activate.invalidLink: This link isn't valid. If you were invited, ask your company administrator for a new invitation.
activate.alreadyActive: Your account is already active. Log in with your email and password.
activate.renewalAvailable: You can ask for a new one.
activate.renewalRequested: Request sent. A new invitation will arrive by email once it's sent to you.
activate.renewalReissued: A newer invitation has already been sent to you. Use the link in the most recent invitation email.
activate.renewalSignup: Sign up again to get a new link.
activate.renewalCreateCompany: If you were creating a new company, start again to get a new link. Otherwise, ask whoever set up this account for a new one.
activate.renewalNone: Ask your company administrator for a new link.

anketaList.title: 1:1 meetings
anketaList.reshareBannerText: One or more counterparts reset their password, which changed their encryption key. 1:1s you share with them may need to be shared again before they can read them.
anketaList.reshareFailure: Some 1:1s could not be re-shared. Try again later.

createAnketa.title: New 1:1 meeting
createAnketa.counterpartPlaceholder: Type a name or email to search…
createAnketa.templateRegularDescription: The standard recurring check-in — mood, feelings, workload, achievements.
createAnketa.templateOnboardingDescription: For a new working relationship's first meeting — working agreement, work style, and a fresh-eyes audit instead of the regular check-in fields.
createAnketa.templateCareerGrowthDescription: A career conversation (e.g. once a quarter) — energy retrospective, trajectory, stretch opportunities, and a 90-day development plan instead of the regular check-in fields.
createAnketa.templateSupportCheckinDescription: A conversation about energy and workload — what to pause or hand off, what would help protect focus and rest, and concrete next steps, alongside the regular mood and workload questions.
createAnketa.periodicityInherited: You've met before — this pair's periodicity is already set and carries over.
createAnketa.pairHasOpenAnketa: This pair already has an open 1:1, so this one is a one-off: nothing is carried over into it, goals and outcomes added here won't carry on to the pair's next meeting, and archiving it won't schedule one. The pair's regular meetings continue in the other 1:1.
createAnketa.pairHasOpenAnketaHowToSwitch: To use this type for the pair's next regular meeting instead, choose it as the next meeting type when archiving the current one.
createAnketa.companyTemplatesNone: Your company admin can add custom meeting templates.

anketa.notEncryptedHint: Title, description and status are not encrypted
anketa.orIfDidNotHappen: Or, if this meeting didn't happen:
anketa.outcomesNote: Shared list — only the author of an item can edit or check it off; the other side can comment.
anketa.goalsUnencryptedNote: Titles, descriptions and status are stored unencrypted so they can be searched later — checkpoints stay encrypted like everything else.
anketa.archiveOneOff: This is a one-off 1:1 (created while the pair already had another one open): archiving it won't schedule a next meeting, and its goals and open outcomes won't carry over into the pair's regular meetings.
anketa.templateRetired: Your admin retired this template — the next meeting will be a Regular check-in unless you pick another type.
anketa.errorStaleKey: This 1:1 can't be decrypted with your current key — this can happen after a password reset.
anketa.draftUnreadable: Your unpublished draft couldn't be opened — it was encrypted with a key you no longer have, most likely before a password reset. Anything you type now will replace it.
anketa.alreadyArchivedElsewhere: This 1:1 was already archived, by the other participant, in another tab or by an earlier attempt, so the choices from this click may not be the ones that were applied.
anketa.archiveAfterAnswersEdit: Save or cancel your answer edits before archiving.
anketa.errorUpdateGoalStatus: Could not update the goal status.
anketa.errorUpdateDiscussed: Could not update the discussed status.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.deleteConfirmPrompt: Type {email} to permanently delete this account and free its seat. This cannot be undone.
admin.errorLoad: Could not load the admin panel.
admin.inviteSettingsHint: Control who can bring new people onto your company's account.
admin.allowedEmailDomainHint: Leave empty to allow any email domain. Anyone — including an admin — who tries to invite someone outside this domain will see an error.

adminTemplates.title: Meeting templates
adminTemplates.intro: Build your company's own 1:1 templates. Anyone in your company can pick an active template for a pair's meetings.
adminTemplates.atCap: Your company has reached the limit of {max} templates, archived ones included. Edit an existing template instead of making a new one.
adminTemplates.archiveNote: Archiving a template hides it from every picker. Pairs using it switch to the Regular check-in at their next archive, unless someone picks another type. Existing 1:1s are unaffected.

adminTemplateEditor.privacyNote: Template names, descriptions and questions are stored unencrypted. Anyone in your company, including employees, can see them, and the server can see which template each meeting uses. Don't include people's names or anything that reveals why a particular meeting is happening. Answers are always end-to-end encrypted.
adminTemplateEditor.archivedReadOnly: This template is archived, so it can't be edited. Restore it to make changes.
adminTemplateEditor.nameHint: Visible to everyone in your company.
adminTemplateEditor.createdButNotLoaded: The template was saved, but it couldn't be loaded here. Reload the page to edit it; don't create it again.
adminTemplateEditor.changesNote: Changes apply to new 1:1s and to the next meeting of pairs using this template; existing 1:1s keep the version they were created with. This page doesn't show how many meetings use a template, so assume any save reaches every pair using it.
adminTemplateEditor.reportNote: Custom questions don't appear in the Report page. Removing Mood or Workload breaks those pairs' trend lines.
adminTemplateEditor.periodicityNote: Templates repeat at the pair's meeting frequency. For an occasional format, pick it for one meeting and switch back at the next archive.

conflict.version_conflict: This template was changed by someone else. Reload to see their version; your changes here are kept until you do.
conflict.template_archived: This template was archived by someone else, so it can't be saved. Reload to see it.

adminTemplateEditor.fixErrors: Fix the problems above to save or preview.
adminTemplateEditor.needsName: Give the template a name to save or preview it.
adminTemplateEditor.undrawable: This template was saved in a form this version of the editor can't show, so it can't be edited here. The problems are listed below.

errors.text_too_long: This can't be longer than {max} characters.
errors.schema_version: This template was made by a newer version of the app.
errors.block_count: Each side needs between {min} and {max} questions.
errors.builtin_not_allowed: This standard question can't be used here.
errors.builtin_repeated: This standard question is already in the template.
errors.id_duplicate: This question is in the template twice.
errors.text_length: This can't be empty or longer than {max} characters.
errors.text_chars: Use a single line, without invisible or control characters.
errors.options_count: A choice question needs between {min} and {max} choices.
errors.too_large: The template is too large. Remove some questions or shorten the text.

privateNotes.heading: My private notes
privateNotes.subtitle: Only you can see these — {counterpart} can't, and neither can the server or your company's admins. Publishing your answers doesn't include them. Visible if you share your screen.
privateNotes.demoSubtitle: This is the shared demo account — other visitors can read these notes.
privateNotes.placeholder: Anything you want to remember about this 1:1…
privateNotes.loadErrorReload: Couldn't load your notes. Reload the page, and log in again if asked.
privateNotes.unreadable: These notes can't be opened — most likely because your password was reset after they were written.
privateNotes.stoppedTooLarge: Too long to save — shorten the notes.
privateNotes.stoppedSessionEnded: Your session ended or changed. Reload and log in again in this tab; your unsaved text is kept here.
privateNotes.stoppedResetElsewhere: Your password was reset in another session — this tab can't save anymore. Copy your text, then reload.
privateNotes.conflict: You edited these notes in another tab or device.
privateNotes.conflictUnreadable: These notes were changed in another tab or device, and that version can't be opened here.
privateNotes.loadServerConfirm: Replace this tab's text with the saved version?
privateNotes.footerLoss: Lost if you reset a forgotten password.

templatePortability.copyByHand: Couldn't copy the link automatically. Copy it from here:
